# Town artwork

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. These are fictional illustrations, not maps or photographs of a real place.

Saved assets: `town.png`, `town-drought.png`, `town-flood.png` in this directory.

## Base prompt

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: full-screen background for a facilitator-led Indian climate workshop, landscape 16:9. Create a beautifully detailed hand-painted aerial oblique illustration of fictional Navapur, a contemporary small Indian town: dense low-rise market at center-right, warm plaster houses, workshops, construction at edges, fields, a blue pond lower right, winding roads, electric substation. Editorial gouache and fine pencil, warm ivory paper, terracotta roofs, olive fields, muted teal water, afternoon sun. Town fills the entire frame, with quieter pale fields on left third for large dark title overlay. No text, labels, borders, UI, logos, or lettering. Geographic coherence, human scale, neither fantasy village nor metropolis.

## Drought edit prompt

Edit this illustration for a climate workshop: keep exactly the same aerial camera, town layout, buildings, roads and landmarks. Show the same town in severe summer drought: pond almost dry with cracked mud and a tiny pool, dry brown fields, heat haze and parched trees, roadside rubbish accumulating beside the market. Same detailed gouache style and wide composition. No text, no labels.

## Flood edit prompt

Edit this illustration for a climate workshop: preserve exactly the same aerial camera, town layout, buildings, roads and landmarks. Show monsoon flooding in this same town: pond overflowing into nearby low streets, waterlogged fields, rain and overcast light. Keep roofs and major landmarks recognisable. Same detailed gouache style and wide composition. No text, no labels.
